|rulings=* Light should include this card outside of their deck (it does not count towards their 60 card deck limit).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=The%20Mythrol%20/%20%E2%80%A2The%20Mythrol</ref>
* Only during the start of the game, and only if Dark has just deployed [[Jabba's Prize / Jabba's Prize{{!}}Jabba's Prize]], Light may choose to reveal this card and follow the instructions.
* If Dark does not deploy [[Jabba's Prize / Jabba's Prize{{!}}Jabba's Prize]] (or if Light does not choose to reveal [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Virtual Set 0){{!}}The Mythrol]]), Light simply places this card under their Starting Effect (even if the Starting Effect does not normally allow such cards under it) without needing to reveal it first.
* If Light plays [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed{{!}}You Can Either Profit By This...]] and Dark plays [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration{{!}}Carbon Chamber Testing]] with [[Jabba's Prize / Jabba's Prize{{!}}Jabba's Prize]], and Light chooses to reveal [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Virtual Set 0){{!}}The Mythrol]], then [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Virtual Set 0){{!}}The Mythrol]] will start in the Security Tower and Light will have their [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] card start at Audience Chamber.
* If Light attempts to include this card in their 60-card deck, it will be placed out of play at the start of the game (it cannot be played).
* This card's species is 'Mythrol' and if active (e.g. flipped to the 7-side) would count towards the number of species for [[Ancient Watering Hole (Virtual Set 10){{!}}Ancient Watering Hole]].
